t: This woodscrews trade pack contains 1400 pieces, offering a comprehensive selection of multipurpose screws essential for professional joiners and carpenters on indoor projects. Each carbon steel screw is zinc-plated and yellow-passivated, then wax-coated for corrosion resistance and smoother driving into wood without pre-drilling. The double-countersunk head with underhead ribs ensures a clean, flush finish, while the deep, sharp single thread cuts cleanly. The pack includes fully and partially threaded lengths, compatible with PZ screwdrivers, combi drills and impact drivers, providing reliability for various wood fixing applications.
b: Deep, Sharp, Single Thread for Cutting Cleanly through Wood
PZ Drive Compatible With Power Tools
No Pre-Drilling Required in Most Timbers
